कैशिक a. (की f.) [केश ठक्]
1
Hair-like, fine as hair.
--कः The
sentiment of love, lust.
--कं A
quantity of hair.
--की One of
the four varieties of dramatic style,
more usually and correctly written
कौशिकी q. v.
--2 An epithet of Durgā.

कैशोरं [किशोरस्य भावः अञ्] Youth
childhood, tender age (below
fifteen); कैशोरमापंचदशात्.

कैश्यं The whole mass of hair,
quantity of hair.
